literal_meaning: জগাই এবং মাধাই (দুই ঐতিহাসিক ব্যক্তির নাম)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওরা জগাই-মাধাইয়ের মতো অবিচ্ছেদ্য বন্ধু, কখনো ছাড়ে না।
স্কুলের দুই বন্ধু জগাই-মাধাইয়ের মতো সবসময় একসাথে থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: They are inseparable friends like Jagai and Madhai, always together.
The two school buddies stick together like Jagai and Madhai.
history: Jagai and Madhai were two notorious brothers from Nabadwip who were reformed and converted to Vaishnavism by Chaitanya Mahaprabhu in the 16th century, symbolizing redemption and close brotherhood.
note: This idiom draws from the life story of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, emphasizing transformation from vice to virtue in Bengali folklore.
